title: carbonicality's PvP Utils
description: PvP Utils is the ultimate PvP utility mod you need!
body:
# carbonicality's PvP Utils
PvP Utils is the ultimate PvP utility mod for you!

**Features:**
- totem HUD (displays all of your totems on the left of the hotbar)
- armor HUD (displays armor durability stats on the right of the hotbar)
- fullbright (use the B key to toggle fullbright)
- zoom (use the C key to zoom)
- fps counter
- potion HUD (displays potion with duration without having to enter inventory)
- dynamic shulker contents viewing (you can hover on shulker boxes to view its contents with icons)
- adaptive crosshair (crosshair that turns red when in range to hit)

This mod is only currently compatible with Forge.
Thanks for reading, and have fun!
